decisions.rule: A trial's own posted results in a versioned AACT snapshot count as a PRIMARY source on the page (route SWEEP_AACT_PRIMARY), only with the recorded registry binding: NCT, the registry outcome title, the snapshot id + digest, the posted-N = randomised-N guard, and two-arm counts or a two-sided effect with its CI. Anything missing is not counted (fail-closed).

ONE_COMPARABLE_TRIAL passes RESULT_AGREES only when the directly comparable pairs that AGREE carry at least half of the shared trials' participants AND every other shared pair is a named MEASURE_DIFFERENCE with the same conclusion. A pair without a participant count, or a shared pair that is neither, fails closed. One small trial never carries a topic. Participants come from the pair's arm counts, else from the trial's OWN held abstract stating its randomised N (verb before the number, never negated or future, exactly one N; span recorded) -- g1_tracker.stated_randomised_n (corpus: 35 of 296 comparator trials with a held abstract state one).

A comparator that pools no RCTs cannot be matched trial-for-trial by an RCT review: the topic stays in the denominator with status COMPARATOR_POOLS_NO_RCT, a span quoted verbatim from the comparator's own held record, and is listed on the page as not attainable against this comparator. Replacing the comparator is Mahmood's decision.

A meta whose figure prints no pooled result cannot reproduce its own pool (no positive control): its rows count only as a SECOND source beside a gated meta or a primary, never alone (SECOND_SOURCE_ONLY).

A cluster or cluster-crossover trial's unadjusted arm counts are not pooled as if individually randomised: without a unit-of-analysis adjustment the trial is blocked UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS_ADJUSTMENT_UNAVAILABLE (SALT, SMART) and the comparator's unadjusted use is a comparator finding.
